summary:
Goldman (10) and JPM (10) tie for the largest share of this window, with JPM's JPMAM Guide to the Markets deck covering regional valuations, balance-sheet health, retirement assets, and portfolio/real-yield data, while Goldman's equity-strategy chartbook spans SPX/ACWI earnings growth, multiple contraction, style rotation, breakeven inflation, and gold.

Apollo's Slok (1) flagged the diverging debt-servicing burden between corporates (net interest down to 0.4% of GDP) and the federal government (now paying 3.6% on new long-term debt).

No Neil Sethi (@neilksethi / @neilksethinew) items appeared in this window, and no duplicate charts or text were found to collapse — all 21 kept items were unique, single-instance charts relayed by MikeZaccardi.

**By bank:** Goldman 10, JPM 10, Apollo/Slok 1.
